question: What chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes at this point?
premises: The text named is Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
The chapter concerns the arrangement of three storeys.
inference: This marks the end of the twenty-eighth chapter on three-storey arrangement in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, on the arrangement of three storeys, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
